moments.title: Remembrance Day Observance
moments.blurb: The UK observes Remembrance Day today, November 11th, with two minutes of silence at 11 AM to honour those who have served and sacrificed in conflicts.

angles.name: National Silence
angles.copy: At 11 AM today, the nation falls silent. Wherever you are, take two minutes to remember and honour those who gave their lives for our freedom. #RemembranceDay

angles.name: Poppy Appeal
angles.copy: Today is Remembrance Day. Wear your poppy with pride to show your support for our Armed Forces community, past and present. We will remember them.

angles.name: Meaning of 11/11
angles.copy: Why November 11th? It marks the Armistice signed in 1918, signalling the end of World War I. Today, we remember all who have served. #ArmisticeDay

angles.name: Timeless Talent
